story.headline: Hundreds gather in Chicago to try to push the 110-ton Bean sculpture seven inches to the left
story.summary: On Sunday, Nov. 8, hundreds of people gathered at Chicago's Millennium Park after flyers posted around the city and online called for pushing Cloud Gate, known as The Bean, seven inches to the left. Organizers said moving it would free a man trapped inside, a long-running internet joke that CBS Chicago called a satirical claim. The crowd could not move the 110-ton stainless steel sculpture.

quote.text: The plan was simple: Push Chicago's famous Bean (officially a statue named Cloud Gate by Anish Kapoor) seven inches to the left.
